description:
The CT Cranium DICOM dataset is loaded in InVesalius 3. A biomedical engineer needs two 3D skull models for different purposes: a high-resolution one for detailed planning and a lower-resolution one for rapid prototyping. 

1. Create a bone segmentation mask (using the Bone preset, 226-3071 HU).
2. Generate a 3D surface at 'Best' quality settings (uncheck 'Decimate' or set to maximum quality if available).
3. Export this high-quality surface as a binary STL to `/home/ga/Documents/skull_best.stl`.
4. Generate a SECOND 3D surface at a lower quality setting (e.g., 'Optimal', 'Normal', or by using decimation).
5. Export this lower-quality surface as a binary STL to `/home/ga/Documents/skull_lowres.stl`.

Both files must be created in the same session. The 'best' file must have a significantly higher triangle count than the 'lowres' file.
